resources.string: Report a problem with this insight

Tell the developer what is wrong with this insight. The report opens in your mail app, addressed to %1$s, and reaches the developer only if you send it from there. Until then your mail app handles it as any message you write, which may keep a draft in your mail account.
Exactly this, and never your API keys, history or settings. Your mail app adds your email address as the sender.
Choose what is wrong to see the report.
No mail app on this phone can take the report. Copy it, and send it to %1$s from wherever you write email.
Copied. Paste it into an email to %1$s.
Paste it into an email to %1$s.
The report is long, and some mail apps open it without its text. It is copied too: if the message to %1$s is empty, paste it there.
